league.idsSanitized: no Sleeper league/user/roster ids or team names are written

preseason.floorNote: the 2026-08-25 board priced no player below this value, so the <500 and 500-1000 pre-season bands are EMPTY by construction (players past the rank cap were unpriced then -> 'unvalued'); today's board prices off-cap players
preseason.basis: LIVE export exports/latest/dynasty_data_2026-08-25.json — the board production actually serves

today.methodology: TODAY's code at this commit (build_api_data_contract), not the methodology that served on the archive date

values.unvaluedMeans: the board did not price this player (unpriced row or not on the board) - UNKNOWN, never a value of 0

scorer.what: canonical scorer (source='sleeper') vs host players_points, rostered player-weeks

solver.what: canonical exact solver (realized_points) vs host best-ball starters
solver.note: identical starter sets can differ only by equal-point ties

method.marginal: optimal(roster) - optimal(roster without player), canonical solver on that week's actual points; 0 for a non-starter by construction
method.marginalVsFreeAgent: optimal(roster) - optimal(roster without player + a free agent at his position): the value of his roster SPOT over the wire. The free agent is the best / 3rd-best player on NO roster at the current snapshot, ranked by weeks-1..N total (HINDSIGHT selection), with his actual points that week. Negative = a free agent in that spot would have scored more. Computed for every rostered player-week (bench players are <= 0 by construction)
method.shareOfLeagueStartingPoints: points this cell supplied while started / all starting points league-wide
method.smallSample: flagged when < 30 player-weeks or < 8 distinct players
method.byeWeeks: kept (a rostered bye week is a real 0-utility roster week)

q1_q2_byTodayBand.note: same rows banded by TODAY's board - partly circular (today's values already absorbed weeks 1-6), shown for comparison only

q3_rosterStructure.basis: CURRENT Sleeper rosters (week-7 snapshot), banded by PRE-SEASON value

replacementLevels_realizedPpgWeeks1toN.note: rosValue := mean weekly points while rostered (weeks 1..N), rosters as of the last week; point estimates erase best-ball spikes (see the module docstring)

faabAnchors.note: starters_per_team=20 excludes K (anchors.excludedPositions), as the waiver route passes it

definitions.startedButRedundant_zeroMarginal: started, but an equal bench alternative existed every time (marginal 0)
definitions.lineupContributor_butReplaceableFromWaiv: positive marginal over the bench, but the 3rd-best free agent in his spot would have done as well or better over weeks 1..N
definitions.usableDepth_beatsFreeReplacement: positive marginal over the bench AND over the 3rd-best free agent

caveats: 6 weeks only: per-player season marginals are noisy; cell means with smallSample=true should not be quoted alone
free agents are those on no roster NOW; the hindsight-best FA is an upper envelope a manager could not pick in advance, and best ball requires rostering before the week
marginal vs bench measures realized lineup utility in THIS league's 58-man best-ball format; deep benches dilute any single depth player's marginal
pre-season value of in-season breakouts and undrafted players is low or unvalued by construction; that is the question being asked, not a defect
2025 (10 teams, different format) was not used: no pre-season board on this scale exists before 2026-07-14
